grammar_focus: Pseudo-cleft sentences with a wh-nominal clause as the first part
explanation: The stem opens a pseudo-cleft, so the completion must be a wh-nominal clause that names the content of the puzzle. Ukrainian speakers may place a finite clause after 'was' without the wh-word, because Ukrainian word order and clause linking are more flexible here, but English requires a wh-clause that fills the 'what' slot.
